anxiety.name: Anxiety
anxiety.shortDescription: Anxiety may occur when alcohol use stops, sometimes in a fluctuating way.

sleep_disturbance.name: Sleep disturbance
sleep_disturbance.shortDescription: Insomnia or other sleep changes may occur.

seizures.name: Seizures
seizures.shortDescription: In severe alcohol withdrawal, seizures can occur. They are a serious complication; they do not say what will happen to any one person.

medical_care.name: Medical care
medical_care.shortDescription: Acute alcohol withdrawal can be dangerous. After heavy or dependent use, medical supervision is recommended, and medical care if symptoms intensify.

anhedonia.name: Anhedonia
anhedonia.shortDescription: Anhedonia or lack of motivation may occur.

anhedonia.name: Anhedonia
anhedonia.shortDescription: Anhedonia, apathy, or a reduced ability to feel pleasure may occur.

fatigue.name: Fatigue
fatigue.shortDescription: Intense fatigue or physical exhaustion may occur.

hypersomnia.name: Hypersomnia
hypersomnia.shortDescription: A greater than usual need for sleep may occur.

disrupted_sleep.name: Disrupted sleep
disrupted_sleep.shortDescription: Sleep may be disrupted even with tiredness, or feel irregular.

craving.name: Craving
craving.shortDescription: A strong urge to use again may occur, sometimes intermittently.

restlessness.name: Mental restlessness
restlessness.shortDescription: Mental restlessness may occur together with tiredness.

uneven_energy.name: Uneven energy
uneven_energy.shortDescription: Energy may feel uneven: sometimes wired, sometimes flat.

irritability.name: Irritability
irritability.shortDescription: Irritability may occur when nicotine use stops.

concentration_difficulty.name: Difficulty concentrating
concentration_difficulty.shortDescription: Difficulty concentrating may occur, sometimes leftover.

craving.name: Craving
craving.shortDescription: A strong or occasional urge for nicotine may occur.

anhedonia.name: Anhedonia
anhedonia.shortDescription: Mild anhedonia or lack of motivation may occur.

irritability.name: Irritability
irritability.shortDescription: Irritability may occur when cannabis use stops.

sleep_disturbance.name: Sleep disturbance
sleep_disturbance.shortDescription: Insomnia or irregular sleep may occur.

vivid_dreams.name: Vivid or unsettling dreams
vivid_dreams.shortDescription: Vivid or unsettling dreams may occur.

headache.name: Headache
headache.shortDescription: Headache may occur after regular caffeine use stops; it is often severe.
